mgmt_bio.text: David Rosa became CEO of Intuitive Surgical in 2025, succeeding Gary Guthart, who had led the company since 2010. Rosa is a long-tenured insider, having joined Intuitive in 1996 and held leadership roles spanning engineering, clinical and product development, and marketing. Under this team, capital allocation priorities center on reinvesting in the business, tuck-in M&A focused on acquiring international distributors to go direct, and returning excess capital via buybacks.

sentences.text: Dave Rosa, who became chief executive on 1 July 2025 with former CEO Gary Guthart moving to executive chair, has continued reshaping the leadership team.

On 28 May 2026 Intuitive named Taylor Patton, previously global senior vice president of its endoluminal business, chief commercial and marketing officer effective 1 July 2026, succeeding Henry Charlton, who became senior vice president of global business operations.
In the March 2026 proxy, Guthart wrote that Rosa has made and will continue to make changes the Board believes support the mission, global growth and leader development.
